SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-12: FHIRPath — §5.8 Tree Navigation, §5.9 Utility Functions. Test these items: children(), descendants(), trace(name, [projection]), now(), timeOfDay(), today(). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.evidence: Fresh FP-12 probe showed native fhirpath_is_valid returned true and native result UDFs ignored extra arguments for children(1), descendants(1), now(1), today(1), and timeOfDay(1), while forced Python fallback rejected them. The spec signatures are children(), descendants(), now(), timeOfDay(), and today() with no parameters.
issues.root_cause: Native evalFunction did not include Section 5.8/5.9 zero-argument functions in exact arity validation, so parsed child arguments were ignored.
issues.resolution: Added native exact zero-argument checks for children, descendants, now, today, and timeOfDay; added native sqllogictest and Python/native parity coverage.
issues.verified_in: python3 .temp/qa/fp12_skeptic_probe.py; pytest fhir4ds/fhirpath/duckdb/tests/integration/test_tree_utility_parity.py -q; native sqllogictest 522 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822

issues.evidence: Fresh FP-12 probe showed native fhirpath_is_valid accepted trace(), trace(1), and trace('x', id, id); forced fallback also accepted trace(). The spec signature is trace(name : String [, projection : Expression]) and says projection is evaluated for logging while the input is returned unchanged.
issues.root_cause: Native trace dispatch ignored all AST children and returned input directly; fallback registry incorrectly allowed zero-argument trace.
issues.resolution: Required trace to have one or two arguments, validated a singleton String name in native, evaluated optional native projection for logging semantics/errors, and removed fallback zero-argument trace arity.
